name: Buffalo Veggie Ground Sloppy Joes with Blue Cheese, Celery & Cucumber
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, veggie ground, carrots, and salt; cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until the carrots are softened and veggie ground is browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve celery lengthwise; cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, trim, and quarter cucumber lengthwise; cut crosswise into 3-inch long pieces. Add to the plate with the celery and set aside.
When the veggie ground is done, add tomato sauce and hot sauce to the skillet. Stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Place bottom half of each bun on a plate. Top with saucy veggie ground and blue cheese, then close with the top half of each bun. Serve with veggies and dressing on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
